headline: Referred ordinance placing the Parking Division within the Manchester Police Department; sick leave change remains tabled.
summary: One ordinance amendment would place the Parking Division within the Manchester Police Department. It was voted that it ought to pass and be referred to the Committee on Accounts, Enrollment & Revenue Administration. A sick leave ordinance amendment remains on the table, where it was placed on June 2, 2026, at the request of the Human Resources Department.

Sick leave ordinance amendment remained on the table and was not acted on.

Amending Section 33.081 Sick Leave (D) to change the terms of sick leave use
transcript:
## COMMITTEE ON BILLS ON SECOND READING

October 6, 2026 at 6:00 PM

Chairman Trisciani called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Trisciani, Terrio, Fajardo, Kantor, Dexter

1. Ordinance Amendment:

“Amending Chapter 70: Motor Vehicles and Traffic of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Manchester by amending Section 70.44 Division Established hereby placing the Parking Division within the Manchester Police Department.”

On motion of Alderman Terrio , duly seconded by Alderman Fajardo , it was voted that the Ordinance Amendment ought to pass and be referred to the Committee on Accounts, Enrollment & Revenue Administration.

TABLED ITEM

2. Ordinance Amendment:

“Amending Section 33.081 Sick Leave (D) of the Code of Ordinances of the City of Manchester to change the terms of sick leave use.”

(Note: Tabled on June 2, 2026, at the request of the Human Resources Department.)

This item remained on the table.

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Kantor , duly seconded by

Alderman Fajardo , it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee
